doc: Sprint off the peak, jump, double jump, a third press opens the glider; steer, close with G (glide_toggle), fall, reopen with G, steer left, close and fall to the slope below. Generated by client/src/sim/golden/generate.ts on worldgen.wasm (collision_height, water_height). Replay: start at `initial` (staminaMax in fine units), apply each frame with dt and env, compare to states[i]. Row: [x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,airJumps,mode,stamina,timer,lunge,flags]. See client/src/sim/README.md.
